title: tunnels / Getting Started
content:
## Getting Started

You have two paths to work with tunnels:

* Run the `tunnel` command of the `code` [command-line interface (CLI)](/docs/configure/command-line.md#create-remote-tunnel).
* Enable tunneling through the {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Desktop UI.

Both of these paths result in the same tunneling functionality – you can use whichever tooling works best for you. The CLI is a great option if you can't install the full {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Desktop on your remote machine. Using the {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Desktop UI is convenient if you're already doing some work in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} and would then like to enable tunneling for your current machine.

We'll describe both paths in the sections below.
